note.question: How can nonparametric pricing bandits leverage informational externalities to learn the demand curve?
note.overview: The paper develops monotonic nonparametric Gaussian process bandits based on microeconomic theory for learning the demand curve, leveraging informational externalities to improve pricing decisions.
